text: Ntfyx 是面向 DSH 的手机通知与回复插件，通过原生 bundle 将本机 ntfyx CLI 作为 MCP 服务接入 DSH，并注册随包提供的 ntfyx skill。它可发送任务通知和富内容报告、向手机提问并接收经本机验证的回复，也支持取消待处理问题与本地校验消息。适合希望在手机上查看任务进展或回答 DSH 问题的用户；需要安装本地 Ntfyx CLI，受保护消息还需先完成手机配对。

Ntfyx connects DSH to the local Ntfyx CLI as an MCP service and registers a bundled skill. Agents can send phone notifications and reports, ask questions and receive locally verified replies, cancel questions, and validate messages. Install the CLI; protected messages need phone pairing.
想让 DSH 把任务进度通知发到我的手机上。
我能不能用手机回答 agent 在执行中提出的问题？
Need to send a rich task report from DSH to my phone.
Ntfyx 的功能「手机提问与验证回复」：DSH 可通过注册的 MCP 工具向用户发送选择题、文本问题或确认问题，并等待同一请求的结果；回复由本地 CLI 验证并领取后供 agent 使用。
Ntfyx 的功能「手机通知和富报告」：agent 可调用 Ntfyx 发送任务完成或失败通知，也可把文本、Markdown 或结构化内容作为报告发送到手机。

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Ntfyx for DeepSeek Harness：[中文](README.zh.md) · [Ntfyx](https://ntfyx.me/) · [Install the CLI](https://ntfyx.me/install/)

Send task notifications and rich reports from DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) to your phone. Ask a question, answer with buttons or text on iPhone, Android or a phone-authorized Web Inbox, and let the local Ntfyx CLI verify and claim the reply before the agent continues.

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Ntfyx for DeepSeek Harness：**Plugin 0.1.0 · Ntfyx CLI 0.6.0+ · DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2 · Node.js 24.9+.** DSH is in developer preview; this initial release declares only the DSH version it was checked against.

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Install：Install the signed Ntfyx CLI without configuring another agent:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://ntfyx.me/install.sh | bash
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
ntfyx version --json
ntfyx connect

`connect` is needed for protected notifications and phone questions. Scan and authorize the connection from Ntfyx 1.8.0+ and select a protected Topic. Public Topic operations require no pairing.

Install the native bundle in the DSH profile you use:

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-ntfyx@0.1.0
dsh web
```

Replace `web` with your profile name. If you launch DSH through npx, use `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.2` in place of `dsh`. DSH's plugin command also requires pnpm on PATH. Restart an already running profile after installation.

GitHub is an alternative package source; the bundle ships ready to use and has no build or installation scripts:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:KaylaONeal/dsh-plugin-ntfyx#v0.1.0
```

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Install：Tell DSH:

> Read the ntfyx skill, then use Ntfyx to ask me a test question on my phone. Use Ntfyx for decisions and send a completion notification for this task.

An actual signed reply returning to the waiting agent verifies the phone workflow. A successful installation alone does not verify phone delivery.

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Discover in the DSH interface：If you enable DSH's experimental **Custom plugin indexes** bundle, open **Plugins → Discover → Add index source** and add:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KaylaONeal/dsh-plugin-ntfyx/main/plugins.json
```

This is the Ntfyx-maintained index. It shows the native bundle with its icon, English/Chinese details and install confirmation; it does not make the plugin a DeepSeek-maintained Official bundle.

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · What the bundle provides：The native `cordis.patch.yml` starts your installed `ntfyx mcp` through DSH's official MCP client and registers the bundled `ntfyx` skill. The package includes English and Chinese plugin details and an icon for DSH's Plugins page. It contains no credentials, transcript uploader, hosted MCP endpoint or replacement approval engine.

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · What the bundle provides：| Capability | DSH tool |
| --- | --- |
| Protected notifications and rich reports | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_send` |
| Phone questions | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_ask` |
| Wait for and claim a verified answer | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_result` |
| Cancel a pending question | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_cancel` |
| Local rich-message validation | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_validate_message` |
| Public Topic notifications and reads | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_public_send`, `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_public_read` |
| Paired Inbox usage | `mcp__ntfyx__ntfyx_usage` |

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · What the bundle provides：Use one `session_id` for the current task's updates and questions. Pending questions keep the same `request_id`; continue only after `status: "answered"` and `consumption.claim_acquired: true`. For a confirmation, only `response.value: "allow"` permits the described action. Denial, timeout, cancellation and failed verification never mean consent. Existing authorization and the user's channel choice remain in force.

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · What the bundle provides：Completion notifications are agent tool calls. This version has no automatic lifecycle hooks, does not intercept native DSH questions, and does not approve DSH tool-permission prompts. DSH's normal permission policy still controls tool execution.

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Update or remove：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update --latest dsh-plugin-ntfyx
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-ntfyx
```

Restart the profile. Removing the bundle preserves your Ntfyx CLI and paired credentials.

For a GitHub installation, install the new release tag with `add github:KaylaONeal/dsh-plugin-ntfyx#vNEW_VERSION`; updating a pinned tag does not select a newer tag.

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Verify locally：From a checkout of this repository, with Node 24+ and npm installed:

```sh
npm test -- --ntfyx /absolute/path/to/ntfyx
```

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Verify locally：The test installs a small set of official DSH runtime packages with install scripts disabled, packs this bundle, and boots its real patch in an isolated profile. It checks Ntfyx MCP discovery, local message validation and installed skill discovery. It uses an unpaired temporary identity store, calls no model, and sends no notification. Evidence is saved under `.local/dsh-plugin-test/`. Use `--runtime PATH` to reuse a runtime created by an earlier run.

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Troubleshooting：Run `ntfyx doctor` and `ntfyx version --json` in the environment that launches DSH. Desktop launchers must also have `ntfyx` on PATH. The bundle's MCP entry ID is `ntfyx-mcp`; its transport timeout allows a 45-second Ntfyx question/result wait. If the CLI is absent or cannot start, DSH logs an MCP connection error and continues; fix PATH and restart. Avoid adding a second MCP client named `ntfyx` in the same scope.

DSH's `--dump-config` can inspect composition without starting plugins:

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Troubleshooting：```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

That command does not prove MCP connectivity or phone delivery. Linux runtime checks and local rich-message validation are recorded in the release notes. Other operating systems and real DSH-to-phone delivery require separate acceptance.

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Distribution and privacy：This is the Ntfyx-maintained community plugin for DSH. DeepSeek currently distributes its own Official bundles and ships no default third-party plugin index. The upstream contribution guide recommends publishing a GitHub repository with the `dsh-plugin` topic and currently does not accept external pull requests. See the [official contribution guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [plugin-index guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/guide/plugin-market.md).

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Distribution and privacy：Protected messages and answers are encrypted on devices; the service handles routing metadata and ciphertext. Public Topic messages are visible to the service and anyone who knows the Topic ID, are not end-to-end encrypted, and cannot authorize actions. The user must explicitly accept [the public-content terms](https://ntfyx.me/terms/) before the first public send; a Topic link is not consent.

dsh-plugin-ntfyx README · Distribution and privacy：The bundle configuration and skill are MIT licensed. The companion CLI, apps and hosted service follow their own license and [service terms](https://ntfyx.me/terms/). This repository does not contain Ntfyx's application core or a self-hosting distribution. [Privacy](https://ntfyx.me/privacy/) · [Support](https://ntfyx.me/support/).
